observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a metallic/silver top-opening chest freezer with brand text 'SKYVRUN' visible on the lid.
Photo 1 shows a lock mechanism on the lid, body appears clean with no visible dents or rust.

Photo 2 and 3 show the interior open: two compartments divided by a center partition, plastic shelves/baskets on the inner lid, a small control dial visible in the left compartment, interior looks clean and unused-looking.
No power cord, plug, wall socket, compressor, model/serial plate, or display panel is visible in any photo.
No frost, ice, or condensation is visible, consistent with either an unused unit or one that is off.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'BLESSING ODII' overlay the photos; no other identifying marks or stickers are legible.

claims.claim: Bought as brand new 3 months ago
claims.evidence: No receipt, purchase date, or visible wear/age indicator shown in any photo.
No photo or video shows the unit powered on, cooling, frost forming, or a running compressor/control light.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or cool at all (compressor failure, gas leak, electrical fault)
risks.proof: A short video showing the freezer plugged in, control dial turned, and compressor humming or frost/cooling visible after some minutes

risks.risk: Thermostat or control dial may be faulty (dial is visible but untested)
risks.proof: Close-up video of the dial being turned with an audible click or compressor response

risks.risk: Interior gasket/seal condition unknown, could cause poor cooling efficiency
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the door seal/gasket all around the lid
risks.if_unproven: priced as if seal is worn (lower efficiency)

risks.risk: Hidden rust, dents, or damage on the back/bottom not shown in photos
risks.proof: Photos of the rear panel, bottom, and underside of the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume minor wear

risks.risk: No model/serial plate visible, so exact capacity/litre size and manufacture year can't be confirmed
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating/serial plate (usually inside or on the back)
risks.if_unproven: priced using the lowest common capacity for this body size/style

proof_requests: Video of the freezer plugged in and running, showing the thermostat dial turned and the compressor audibly working
Close-up photo of the rating/serial plate showing model number and capacity
Photo of the rear panel and compressor unit
Close-up photo of the door seal/gasket condition
Photo of the power cord and plug
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a SKYVRUN-branded chest freezer from the visible lid branding, but no photo or clip demonstrates it powering on or cooling, so the working claim remains unverified and must be priced at worst case as not working.
